articleTitle: Design of Real-Time Media Encrypted Conference System Based on WebRTC
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Video conferencing systems have a wide range of demands, and the development of video conferencing technology has driven the growth of network traffic. Real-time communication technologies like WebRTC are widely used in scenarios such as video conferencing, online chat, and audio-video calls. The security and privacy issues of real-time communication are pressing concerns. Audio and video encryption methods typically involve selecting specific content for encryption during the encoding process, and this encryption method requires the implementation of specific encoders and decoders, making it less versatile. This paper designs a video conferencing system that supports audio and video encryption. It encrypts the real-time audio and video streams after encoding and selectively encrypts video streams to improve performance. The system strikes a balance between security and efficiency, effectively safeguarding the security of video conference content.

articleTitle: Discovery of Obstacles to Fusion of Millimeter Wave Radar and Visual Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the practicality of autonomous driving technology, the detection of obstacles on the road has become more important. In this article, we have improved the SAF-FCOS algorithm for spatial attention fusion obstacle detection based on MmWave radar and visual sensors. Due to the missing vertical coordinates of the radar point cloud, we changed the way we generated the point cloud image and removed the distance information that interfered with the detection results. At the same time, we changed the original feature fusion method and applied concat fusion to more levels of features in radar point cloud images. The experimental results show that the improved fusion method can achieve good performance.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Quadrotor UAV Control System Utilizing Sliding Mode Control Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This research delves into the practical implementation and simulation of sliding mode control theory within the context of quadrotor UAV control systems. Initially, a control model for the quadrotor UAV is established using linearization and decoupling techniques. Building upon this model, two distinct sliding mode controllers are devised to govern the attitude angle and flight altitude separately. The feasibility of the designed sliding surfaces is corroborated through the application of Lyapunov’s second method. Within the Simulink environment, step and sinusoidal signals are employed to replicate constant and variable disturbances, respectively, facilitating simulation experiments in both disturbance-free and disturbance-affected scenarios. The outcomes reveal that the proposed sliding mode controller efficiently achieves precise flight objectives in an undisturbed setting, exhibiting robust control capabilities. However, the control system encounters certain challenges in disturbed environments, particularly against variable disturbances. This study not only underscores the efficacy of sliding mode control in UAV control system design but also highlights its limitations in coping with complex disturbances, offering valuable insights for future research endeavors.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Gastrointestinal Tumor Detection based on Multimodal Large-scale Models in the Medical Domain
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: A new Chinese gastrointestinal tumor visual language medical model is proposed. This model integrates text and image analysis capabilities, allowing it to simultaneously explain gastrointestinal tumor images and text. The model adopts a framework design that combines a visual transformer and a foundation language model in two parts. It enhances the abilities of feature matching and instruction learning in two stages through deep training. This method improves the model's ability to perform medical summarization and answer complex medical questions. In addition, a gastrointestinal tumor medical image dataset has been organized. It contains more than 20,000 medical images paired with corresponding text. These medical resources have been organized to facilitate comprehensive interpretation of gastrointestinal tumors, which is conducive to assisting gastrointestinal tumor detection and identification. In summary, the introduction of this model and dataset can greatly promote Chinese gastrointestinal tumor detection and recognition, and provide help for many medical workers and patients.

Author Keywords: large-scale model in the medical field

articleTitle: Improved Wide&Deep Recommendation Algorithm for User Behavioural Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In today's era of rapid data and information growth, people are exposed to more and more complex information. Recommendation system solves the problem of how to accurately deliver information to users, and also helps companies better understand user needs. According to the user's market demand, constantly improve the product experience. By analysing users' information in different areas, we can recommend products that meet their needs and interests in a multi-dimensional way. By analysing the user's behaviour, personal interests and other relevant information, we can improve the recommendation algorithm to push the items that the user is interested in, thereby improving the user experience and increasing the user's time of use.In recent years, many models based on Wide&Deep recommendation algorithms have been proposed.The Wide&Deep model can solve many problems of traditional algorithmic models, but at the same time there are also problems such as large data requirements and complex feature engineering. Based on this, a new Deep&iFFM model is proposed, which cross-fertilises each set of features to achieve the selection of different boosting methods for different attributes. The accuracy can be further improved by the collected dataset of user articles.

articleTitle: A Natural Light Simulation Mathematical Model for Mixed Reality Simulation Cockpit
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This paper introduces a mathematical model for simulating natural light, grounded in the simple sky model and advanced sun positioning techniques. By processing inputs like time, geographical coordinates, and weather, it accurately computes natural light scenarios, replicating sun positioning, angles, intensity, and realistic environmental illumination.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Big Data Based on Ancient Tree Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: For a long time, tree information management has always been at the level of extensive management. Landscaping information mostly uses traditional paper data management, which is mutually related to forest greening information, which brings great inconvenience to each other. Based on the application of big data in the background of ancient tree monitoring, this paper develops an ancient tree monitoring system based on big data, which constitutes a whole, real-time, dynamic and shared operation system of ancient tree monitoring, analysis and application. This system can manage the massive data accumulated by the ancient tree monitoring station for a long time and carry out various clustering analysis on the data. The system needs to be able to receive data information sent by data acquisition points and persist these data. Users can access the system through the browser or mobile terminal and view relevant data information. Through image analysis and big data clustering analysis technology, ancient tree species are classified and identified by multisource remote sensing, and through spatial image imaging technology, the intelligent analysis ability of multi-source remote sensing images of ancient tree species is improved, and the ability of remote sensing information monitoring and identification of ancient tree species is improved.

articleTitle: Method of Distribution Network Topology Verification Based on PCC-ED
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Currently, there are numerous errors or missing data in the distribution network's topological data on the power grid GIS platform, which is inconsistent with the actual topological structure of the distribution network, severely affecting the normal operation of the power grid company's daily business. Manual verification faces high subjectivity when dealing with such a large number of lines. Therefore, this paper proposes a method for verifying the topological structure of the distribution network based on PCC-ED (Pearson Correlation Coefficient and Euclidean Distance). Firstly, the similarity analysis of the power curve of the feeder lines in GIS and the actual lines is conducted through a curve analysis method combining Pearson and Euclidean distances to determine the correctness of the feeder line's topological structure. The feeder lines are categorized, and the low-similarity lines are given priority for detection. At the same time, for the low-similarity lines, the changes in the actual topological structure caused by switch positions need to be excluded. Therefore, an improved depth-first search method is used to determine the actual topological structure of each feature point in the feeder line at each moment based on GIS, and the original data is modified to ensure the accuracy of the results.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning to Optimize Resource Allocation and Management Strategies in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This study aims to explore the application of machine learning technology in resource allocation and management in universities. As educational data grows and the complexity of higher education management increases, traditional resource management methods face many challenges. To this end, this paper uses a variety of machine learning models, including time series analysis, decision trees, and random forests, to optimize student enrollment prediction, teacher allocation, and teaching resource management. Through the analysis of real data, this study demonstrates the effectiveness of machine learning models in terms of prediction accuracy and resource optimization. In addition, the research also developed a university resource management decision support system, which can analyze and predict data in real time to assist managers in making more accurate decisions. The results of this study show that machine learning technology can significantly improve the efficiency and effectiveness of resource allocation in colleges and universities, and is of great significance in guiding the practice of higher education management.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Road Target Detection Method Based on Improved Lightweight YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Aiming at the current YOLOv5s on the edge devices are susceptible to energy consumption and memory, which makes the traditional YOLO series algorithms recognition efficiency is low, for this reason, this paper proposes a road target detection algorithm based on the improved YOLOv5s. The algorithm adopts the WIoU loss function with a two-layer attention mechanism to raise the network's localisation accuracy of the target; adds the SE attention mechanism to the tail of the backbone network to help the network obtain important information; uses the GhostNet network to replace some of the backbone network convolutional layers in the original YOLOv5s network making the model less parametric. The experimental results show that the improved YOLOv5s has a 2.3% improvement in degree of preciseness in detection and the number of parameters has decreased by about 7% tested on the KITTI dataset, which makes it more practical.

articleTitle: A Fine-grained Human Gait Recognition Algorithm Based on Unordered Video Sequences
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Gait recognition is an effective and unique biometric recognition pattern, and the performance of the algorithm mainly depends on its ability to extract and distinguish features from spatial temporal sequences. To improve the robustness of fine-grained human gait recognition algorithms, this paper proposes a deep gait recognition algorithm based on unordered sequences. Firstly, this article expands the Casia-C dataset to a new large-scale human gait behavior dataset; Secondly, multi-scale serialized feature extraction is performed on shallow to deep features. The improved Gaitset model enhances the mining of fine-grained sequence level features, while preserving the temporal input independence of the original Gaitset model, achieving fast, flexible, and effective gait recognition tasks. Finally, this article designs and implements the overall process from video capture, human contour segmentation and preprocessing to gait behavior recognition. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm significantly improves accuracy and robustness in different walking states on the most widely used dataset in the field of gait recognition, CASIA-B (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences) and the expanded CASIA-C dataset.

articleTitle: Voxelization Algorithm Based on Octree Spatial Averaging
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This paper proposes a high-precision and efficient voxelization algorithm for the development of voxelization in the preprocessing stage of industrial simulation. The main idea is to establish an octree data structure to evenly divide the three-dimensional mesh model space into voxel sets. By using the separation axis method and the improved scan line method, the position relationship between voxels and triangles can be directly determined by skipping the calculation of intersection between voxels and triangles. The innovation of this article lies in the use of the separation axis algorithm and the improved scanning line method for voxelization, and the simplification of the algorithm's operations through the octree data structure, thereby reducing the time and spatial complexity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Wind Power and Photovoltaic Scene Generation and Reduction Method Based on Improved Gaussian Mixture Model of Cuckoo Search
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: A method for generating and reducing distributed power generation output scenarios based on improved clustering analysis is proposed to address the issues of low accuracy and susceptibility to local optima in typical Gaussian mixture model clustering. Using the K-means clustering results as the initial value, the cuckoo search algorithm is used to solve for the optimal solution of GMM parameters, forming the CS-GMM improved clustering algorithm. Based on Latin hypercube median sampling, generate a large number of distributed power generation output scenarios, use CS-GMM algorithm to complete scene reduction, and obtain the reduced scenario results and the proportion of each scenario. This article verifies through experiments that the CS-GMM algorithm outperforms other comparison algorithms and has good application prospects by comparing the silhouette coefficient, Davies-Bouldin index and Calinski Harabasz score after clustering.

articleTitle: A Scheme for Network Capacity Region Optimization in the Fog Stochastic Network
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The efficient task offloading and scheduling mechanisms in fog computing networks can significantly enhance the service quality for IoT applications. However, a fundamental problem in this domain lies in determining the optimal number of fog nodes and selecting the most suitable offloading nodes. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to address this issue by proposing a method to accurately estimate the required number of fog nodes while ensuring network stability. Meanwhile, we also delve into the tradeoffs involved in offloading tasks to nearby fog nodes versus remote fog nodes to delineate the network capacity region. Then, we establish a lower bound on the number of tasks that should be offloaded to remote fog nodes, considering both task execution times and their associated delay-deadlines. Finally, the simulation results show the efficacy of our proposed method in upholding network stability.

articleTitle: Spectral Efficiency Comparison Via Implement Different Modulation Schemes within ASK, FSK and PSK
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Within the rapid development of wireless communications, the demand for techniques enabling efficient use of the electromagnetic spectrum is a leading concern in communication research. This report presents a comprehensive analysis of three predominant modulation schemes - Amplitude Shift Keying (ASK), Frequency Shift Keying (FSK), and Phase Shift Keying (PSK) - with a focus on their spectral efficiencies and the inherent trade-offs between spectral efficiency and Bit Error Rate (BER) performance. Through methodical simulations and empirical data analysis, this study compares the occupied bandwidth and symbol rate requirements of each modulation technique, providing insights into their operational efficiency in different communication scenarios. The ASK, PSK, and FSK modulation schemes have their own advantages and limitations. By focusing on the comparative analysis, it is concluded that the information via each modulation technique may be preferred over the other techniques by considering channel conditions, bandwidth constraints, and the need for reliable data transmission. The evaluation of the trade-off between spectral efficiency and BER performance further contributes to the optimization strategies in wireless communication design. This study aims to serve as a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners in the field of wireless communications, paving the way for more informed decisions in system design and implementation.

articleTitle: Research on Fine Management Methods for Energy Consumption of All Equipment in Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: "Energy conservation and emission reduction" is a hot topic of global concern. To curb global climate change, protect limited Earth resources, reduce energy waste, and promote the application of energy-saving technologies are the goals of all human efforts. The increase in energy costs and the increasingly prominent environmental issues have posed severe challenges to data center (DC). DC plays an important role in the era of big data. With the continuous deployment and construction of DC, its high energy consumption problem is becoming increasingly prominent, and energy management has become the focus of attention in the DC industry. Relying on the construction of the Internet of Things (IOTIPS) for power, DC can achieve real-time monitoring of online equipment and scientific unified energy consumption management, improving the problems of unreasonable equipment distribution and redundant monitoring equipment in traditional DCs. This article designs a refined energy consumption management system for DC full equipment based on IOTIPS. By combining software and hardware, real-time monitoring and refined management of DC's full equipment energy consumption can be carried out. It can statistically and analyze the energy consumption of DC's IT equipment, air conditioning, power supply and distribution, comprehensively evaluate and optimize the energy use of DC, and provide scientific basis for energy conservation and consumption reduction of DC.

articleTitle: Advancements and Applications of Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This article presents an exhaustive exploration of convolutional vectors, a cornerstone concept in deep learning. Initially, it introduces the fundamental principles of convolutional vectors, and then delves into the essential operations that bolster their effectiveness in a broad application scope. The piece begins by examining the basic operations integral to convolutional vectors: convolution, pooling, and flattening. It elucidates how these processes enable convolutional vectors to distill meaningful features from raw data, thereby rendering them exceptionally apt for tasks like image recognition and natural language processing. Following this foundational discussion, the focus shifts to the diverse applications of convolutional vectors across various domains. The article showcases their utility in image classification, object detection, speech recognition, and recommendation systems, among other areas. Through examples and case studies, it illustrates the proficiency of convolutional vectors in addressing real-world challenges. Furthermore, the article ventures into the future trajectory and emerging trends in the realm of convolutional vectors. It highlights ongoing research aimed at enhancing their efficiency and scalability, and discusses their integration with other cutting-edge technologies, such as attention mechanisms and transfer learning. Moreover, the potential implications of convolutional vectors in nascent fields like robotics and autonomous systems are contemplated.

Index Terms: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge

articleTitle: Self-Supervised Monocular Indoor Depth Estimation via Log-SSIM and Two-Step Pose Network
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation based on image sequences has now achieved remarkable results in outdoor scenes. However, self-supervised learning approches on indoor datasets are extremely challenging. First, it is easy to ignore the influence of regions with low absolute pixel values on training by using the structural similarity (SSIM)-based photometric loss function. Another difficulty is that indoor datasets usually have more complex camera poses. In this paper, we propose LTdepth, a novel approach that can address the above issues. In particular, we first design a Log-SSIM function by combining the log-transform and the original SSIM function, which can effectively balance the effect of different pixel values on training. We then integrated a two-step pose estimation network into the basic model PLNet in order to handle the problem of complex camera poses. Extensive experiments on the NYUv2 dataset not only show the validity of the above innovations, but also demonstrate that our model outperforms other state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: A Detection Frame of Metal Surface Defect Based on Improved Deformable-DETR
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of mis-classification, low detection accuracy and poor generalizability of the defect detection methods on metal surfaces, a method based on Deformable-DETR (Detection Transformer) for defect detection on metal surfaces is proposed. An imitation FPN (Feature Pyramid Network) structure is added to the design, the design adds ATSS (Adaptive Training Sample Selection) to assist the Anchor generation header, which solves the problem of sparse positive samples in the encoder by generating customized positive queries. The design of the decoder is improved the accuracy of the last layer output. These improvements improve the learning ability of the end-to-end detector. In particular, the ATSS auxiliary head is not required in the inference phase. An experimental study was conducted on metal surface defect images, and the AP of the improved method reached 66.5%, 98.4%, and 75.6% at different thresholds, which is 11.6%, 1.9%, and 20.4% higher than that of the original method, with more precise detection of the defect location and higher classification accuracy of the defect category.

articleTitle: Chinese Sarcasm Detection Using Title-Attention and Bidirectional LSTM Base on Bert
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Sarcasm is a special linguistic phenomenon, and sarcasm recognition is a challenging natural language processing task. The complexity of Chinese grammar means that sarcasm recognition in Chinese text will be more difficult. Sarcasm often relies on context, implicit language structures, and complex semantic relationships, which makes traditional text classification and sentiment analysis methods difficult to deal with. This article provides a deep learning model that can deeply mine the emotions contained in the text and combine the dependencies between sentences to identify the irony contained in the sentences and analyze the true emotions expressed by the sentences. Moreover, this article proposes a Title-Attention so that the input comment text can be well combined with the news title text. Experiments have proven that this model can help identify the true emotional tendencies in texts and mine sarcastic remarks.

articleTitle: Research on the Standardization of Chinese Clinical Terminology Using RoBERTa
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Clinical terminology in electronic health records is characterized by significant diversity and a lack of standardization, which hampers the analysis and utilization of medical data. Consequently, research on the standardization of clinical terminology holds substantial practical significance. Currently, the standardization of clinical terminology in domestic medical institutions is predominantly conducted manually, a process that is both time-consuming and costly. This paper proposes a method for the standardization of Chinese clinical terminology based on RoBERTa. The method comprises four modules: data preprocessing, RoBERTa-based relevance scoring, re-ranking based on Named Entity Recognition, and prediction of the number of standard terms. The usability of the proposed method was validated on a Chinese dataset annotated by medical professionals and aligned with the SNOMED CT standard. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method excels in the practical application of medical terminology standardization, offering excellent generalizability and practical value in managing medical knowledge features.

articleTitle: Ozone Concentration Prediction Based on CNN-AM-BiLSTM-ResNet
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Green development and ecological civilization is one of the key tasks during China's 14th Five-Year Plan. Ozone is not only one of the air pollutants, but also high ozone concentration may lead to sudden heavy pollution weather, which is harmful to public health and the environment. By predicting ozone concentration, potential high ozone events can be detected in advance, warning information can be issued in time, and appropriate interventions can be executed to lessen the potential ramifications. In this paper, a CNN-AM- BiLSTM-ResNet approach is proposed to predict O3 concentration. a CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) is employed for capturing spatiotemporal patterns within the monitoring station data, an AM (Attention Mechanism with Multiple Heads) handles multifactorial information in the data from a single monitoring station, a BiLSTM is employed for modeling the dynamic features of the time series and capturing the long-term dependencies, and a residual network is used to enhance the expressive power and gradient flow of the model, and finally a fully connected layer to get the ozone concentration prediction results for the future period. The prediction accuracy surpasses that of models based on CNN-LSTM and CNN-BiLSTM architectures, with evaluations conducted using both MAE and RMSE.

articleTitle: Research on Power Grid Visualization Based on Force-Oriented Layout Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: It takes a lot of time and manpower to create and edit the traditional power grid topology. With the advent of the era of intelligent power, the scale of power system is expanding, and the requirements of power grid users for the display effect of power grid topology are also increasing. Therefore, the maintenance workload of topology is increasing. If there is a feasible, efficient and beautiful topological graph automatic generation method to solve this problem, the work efficiency of distribution network production can be further improved. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved force-oriented algorithm to automatically generate the power grid layout under the condition of given power line data and node initial coordinates. The automatic layout algorithm is used to achieve better topology visualization by reorganizing the topology layout. The application example shows that the power grid topology graph created by this method contains fewer intersections and the nodes are evenly arranged, which can significantly improve the visualization effect of the network graph.

articleTitle: Small Target Detection Algorithm of Edge Scene Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Presents an enhanced small target detection algorithm for edge scene applications based on the improved YOLOv8 framework, termed YOLOv8-VCS. The primary focus is on the detection and identification of small objects within edge scenarios, characterized by environments with limited computing resources, such as smart cameras and IoT devices. Recognizing the significance of efficient small target detection in these contexts, the study introduces modifications to the YOLOv8 algorithm to optimize performance in edge computing environments. The proposed YOLOv8-VCS algorithm incorporates three main improvements: the Vanillanet module for model compression, enabling faster and more real-time detection; the Coordinate Attention (CA) module to enhance feature extraction and improve detection accuracy; and the Slicing Aided Hyper Inference (SAHI) algorithm to augment the recognition of small objects, thereby boosting detection precision. These enhancements aim to balance the trade-off between detection speed and accuracy, achieving real-time performance with reduced model complexity. Experimental results, conducted using the Tsinghua-Tencent 100K (TT100K) dataset, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, showing significant improvements in detection accuracy and speed while minimizing model parameters and computational demands. The YOLOv8-VCS algorithm outperforms existing models by achieving higher detection accuracy with fewer parameters and lower computation, making it well-suited for deployment in resource-constrained edge devices.

articleTitle: Paid User Data Mining Approach for a System to Assist with Volunteering for the College Entrance Examination
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Addressing the dilemma that the current paid user mining techniques are complex and unsuitable for some specific applications, the present study suggests a rule-based paid user mining approach to streamline the implementation process. The main process consists of a buried design to produce JSON format logs detailing user usage. These logs are obtained as raw data in topics created with Kafka. Real-time user behavior data is then analyzed, using Spark Streaming computation engine, and matching calculation is executed based on predefined rules to determine a likelihood threshold for the conversion of nonpaying users to paying users. If the conversion probability threshold surpasses the preset level, the system identifies the user as a potential paying customer. Consequently, a message is delivered to the customer based on the outcome. The system might configure the coupon amount contingent upon different thresholds and distinct specified indications. Additionally, it persists in updating the customer's labeling status, ensuring adequately responsive, targeted advertising strategies are present at each customer visit. This method doesn't require intricate machine learning algorithms, making implementation more straightforward and providing crucial technical support for subsequent user operations. The implementation of this design improves the likelihood of user payments and boosts product profits.

articleTitle: A Fast and Efficient Federated Learning Algorithm Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Federated learning faces the problem of large amount of data and long training time while training models. Therefore it becomes necessary to reduce the training data, shorten the training time, and achieve the desired prediction accuracy. Since generative adversarial network has the advantages of comprehensive feature extraction and fast gradient flow, the generative adversarial network is combined with federated learning to improve the hopping layer channel excitation module and self-supervised discriminator module, and a federated learning algorithm based on the self-attentive hopping layer channel excitation module and self-coded discriminator module is proposed. The experimental results show that compared with the typical federated learning algorithm without model optimization, the optimization enables the model prediction accuracy of federated learning to be improved by about 10% on average, and the training runtime is reduced by one quarter of the original on average.

articleTitle: A Neural Network Parallel Computing Approach for Arithmetic Test Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The development of server arithmetic benchmarking is of great significance to the development of the whole chip and the whole server arithmetic. Currently, the existing arithmetic tests are categorized into traditional server arithmetic tests, e.g., Linpack, and AI server arithmetic tests, e.g., MlPerl. Traditional server arithmetic tests are insufficient to reflect the arithmetic power of AI servers, and existing AI servers ignore the limitations of the parallelism method, which leads to the instability of the final test results. In this paper, we propose a parallel computing method, DPipe-C, for benchmarking to balance the contradiction between long testing time and unstable test results during training tests. The method uses a dual-pipe approach in order to reduce the size of bubbles in the parallel process and improve the overall throughput of the system. It also uses synchronization to ensure the stability of its results. In the different stages of data transmission, the data is compressed to improve the overall training efficiency, and the delayed delivery error method is used to reduce the impact of the compression process on the training results to ensure the stability of the results. Using this method, the overall throughput of the system is increased by nearly 20%. At the same time, the training accuracy can reach the original accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Multi-Load Comfort Cost Collaborative Optimization Method Based on BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The access of large-scale different types in load equipment puts higher requirements on the adaptive adjustment ability of grid load. In order to balance the supply and demand equilibrium between the grid and the users, this paper proposes a co-optimization method of multi-load comfort cost based on Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM). Firstly, a hierarchical model of BiLSTM is established based on the peak characteristics of electricity consumption and power consumption of multiple load equipment to achieve multi-level classification of user-side load equipment. Then, the load power function based on user comfort is constructed by combining the equipment categories. With the goal of minimizing the comprehensive cost, the loads on the grid are optimized in a collaborative manner, thus achieving safe peaking and safe operation of the grid. Simulation results based on actual load data show that the proposed method could accurately achieve multiple load classification. It can effectively reduce the peak load while optimizing the comprehensive cost of users, and support the construction, operation, and maintenance of digital power grid.

articleTitle: Construction of Digital Twin Model of Data Center and Its Application in Visualization System
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This study is devoted to the construction of digital twin model of data center and its application in visualization system. Through the comprehensive modeling of data center hardware, software, network and energy, the digital twin model is constructed as a highly accurate and real-time updated virtual entity. By keeping pace with the actual data center, the model provides decision makers with in-depth insight into the running state of the system. In the process of constructing the digital twin model, this study adopts event-driven update mechanism and timing update mechanism to ensure the accuracy and real-time performance of the model. In addition, 3D modeling technology is introduced to present the digital twin model to managers in an intuitive and realistic way, which improves the user experience. The application of digital twin model is not only reflected in resource management, performance monitoring and capacity planning, but also plays an important role in visualization system. Through the visualization system, decision makers can monitor the running status of data centers in real time, analyze historical trends, and obtain key information related to their responsibilities through user-customized views. Through a successful case study, this study shows the value of digital twin model in the actual data center, and provides a powerful tool for data center managers to help them better understand, optimize and make decisions. This research provides beneficial experience and enlightenment for the application of digital twin technology in data center management.

articleTitle: A Multi Object Tracking Algorithm Model Integrating High Order Dynamic Appearance
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Multi object tracking is an important task in computer vision, which refers to the process of continuously inferring the object state in a video or image sequence to generate the target's trajectory. In this paper, for the traditional multi-object tracking algorithm, the feature ReID is upgraded to HOReID. After learning the key points of the target, the image convolution method is used to extract higher-order appearance features to prevent the error transmission caused by noise, and the key point topology map matching is used for soft alignment to solve the problem of object occlusion and camera Angle question. Considering that the continuity of video frames can also be represented by motion features, this paper adopts a strategy of integrating inter frame motion features and appearance features, dynamically adjusting the embedding ratio of appearance features based on confidence, and constructing an adaptive cost matrix to enhance the robustness of target matching. Through validation on the MOT17 public datasets, this algorithm has improved the accuracy of object tracking.

articleTitle: Research on Detecting ChatGPT Rewritten Text
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: ChatGPT enables users to efficiently access information services, driving AI-generated content into the public eye. Generated content is widely used in various fields, including education, entertainment, and medicine. The advancement of models like GPT poses significant challenges in identifying the authors of texts. ChatGPT can mimic human dialogue and provide users with information and advice, but the reliability and credibility of the information it provides have not been verified. For individuals who are not computer professionals, it is difficult to distinguish these high-quality texts from those written by humans. In addition to academic research, commercial organizations have also attempted to classify text sources and have launched online detection tools. Although preliminary research has been carried out on the topic of identifying text generated by large language models, the complexity of the vocabulary and the expressiveness of the generated text further complicate the detection process. The current methods do not ensure robustness and transferability, and the difficulty of detecting text generated by different prompts varies, particularly when the data is embellished with GPT. Although there is no standardized measurement tool, the disparity between the two texts is decreasing. In this paper, we propose a method that utilizes text features as auxiliary signals and expands upon them using the pre-trained language model Roberta. This method has demonstrated exceptional performance on datasets that have been modified by ChatGPT.

articleTitle: Using Contrastive Learning to Optimize the Intention Recognition Model of Sentence Vector Plus CNN Network
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the continuous development of question answering systems, enabling computers to accurately understand the intentions of user questions is of great significance for the entire field of question answering systems. The main goal of intention recognition is to determine the user's intention in the human-machine dialogue process, improve the accuracy and naturalness of the question answering system, and generally achieve it through classification models. This article proposes a new neural network model based on the widely used classification models currently. The sentence vectors generated by the pretrained model are optimized using comparative learning to form a new pretrained model, followed by CNN network feature extraction to improve the recognition ability of the entire model. The proposed neural network model has a certain performance improvement compared to other models, achieving good performance.

articleTitle: Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Speed Control by Attention Mechanism Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is widely utilized across various domains due to its high power density, extensive speed range, and reliability. However, the performance of traditional PID controllers is influenced by system parameters, necessitating manual parameter tuning through trial and error to achieve the desired control outcomes. This process requires significant human effort and time investment. To address these challenges, an improved deep deterministic policy gradient (PPO) self-adaptive controller has been proposed for PMSM control. This controller leverages reinforcement learning along with attention mechanisms. It combines deep neural networks, the Actor-Critic algorithm, and attention mechanisms to achieve autonomous learning and self-tuning of system parameters, ultimately leading to optimal control. Simulation experiments demonstrate that the improved PPO model controller offers distinct advantages over PID controllers in reaching the target speed. It can bring the motor to the target speed more rapidly without noticeable speed transients while also exhibiting a degree of generalization, allowing it to perform well under various conditions.

articleTitle: Prediction of Data Center Cooling Tower Outlet Water Temperature Based on iForest-BiLSTM-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Through Pearson correlation analysis, the inlet water temperature, cooling water flow rate, outdoor dry bulb temperature, outdoor wet bulb temperature, and cooling tower setting frequency of the cooling tower are chosen as the input parameters of the model, and the cooling tower outlet water temperature is the output parameter of the model. These parameters have a strong correlation with the cooling tower outlet temperature. The BiLSTM-CNN neural network model is used to predict the cooling tower outlet water temperature, while the iForest model is used to handle anomalies in feature values and goal values. The BiLSTM-CNN neural network model has 5 layers, each with an Epoch of 100 and a Batch_size of 64: the bidirectional LSTM layer, the 1D convolution layer, the maximum pooling layer, the flatten layer, and the fully connected layer. The BiLSTM-CNN model is found to have the highest R-squared of 0.9996, the lowest MAE and MSE of 0.0671 and 0.0087, and the smallest MSE of 0.0087 when LSTM, BiLSTM, and CNN models are contrasted. As a result, the BiLSTM-CNN neural network is chosen as a useful tool to predict the cooling tower outlet water temperature because it helps to better predict the changing trend of the cooling tower outlet water temperature under various external factors and offers a useful basis for decision-making for the effective operation of the system.

articleTitle: The Utilisation and Implementation of the Istio Framework in the Architectonic Progression of Online Learning Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Online education platforms have become increasingly significant with the rapid development of "Internet + Education". This paper details the evolution of an online learning platform from a traditional monolithic application architecture to a Service Mesh architecture, incorporating the use of the Istio framework. Though efficient in its initial stages, the monolithic structure encountered performance bottlenecks in high concurrency and high throughput scenarios. By implementing the Service Mesh architecture, the platform reduced its latency under identical hardware conditions. The performance tests reveal that, in high concurrency and throughput scenarios, the Service Mesh architecture outperforms traditional microservices and monolithic structures, exhibiting considerable advantages. This highlights the Service Mesh architecture's potential in improving the platform's performance, scalability, and maintainability.

articleTitle: Study on CPU and FPGA in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This article provides a comprehensive examination of the roles played by Central Processing Units (CPUs) and Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) in the realms of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML), with a particular emphasis on the superiorities of FPGA over CPU in certain aspects. It is observed that CPUs, while versatile, fall short in aspects such as power efficiency, handling the intricacies of deep learning models, and performing large-scale matrix computations. FPGAs, on the other hand, are lauded for their remarkable flexibility, low latency, superior energy efficiency, and inherent parallelism—qualities that are immensely beneficial in AI and ML applications. The article delves into the real-world applications of both CPUs and FPGAs, showcasing specific scenarios where each excels. For instance, the low latency advantage of FPGAs is crucial in image processing tasks, where quick, efficient processing can be pivotal. In contrast, CPUs are better suited for smaller-scale or general-purpose computing tasks where flexibility and ease of programming are key. This contrast highlights the nuanced roles that these technologies play in the broader context of AI and ML. Further, the article contrasts CPUs and FPGAs in terms of architecture, design philosophy, and suitability for various AI and ML workloads. While CPUs offer a general-purpose solution with a well-established ecosystem, FPGAs provide a customizable platform that can be tailored to specific needs, offering a more efficient solution for certain types of computational tasks in AI and ML. This comparison not only sheds light on the inherent strengths and weaknesses of each technology but also underscores the importance of choosing the right tool for specific AI and ML applications, thereby optimizing performance, efficiency, and power consumption.

articleTitle: CMBS: Chaotic Mapping and Bit Level Shift Based Image Encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Many scholars have proposed various encryption algorithms to address the correlation and consistency between image pixels, particularly when the entire image exhibits uniformity. However, these algorithms suffer from the problems of not being able to fully realise encryption and being vulnerable to plaintext attacks. Aiming at the problems of how to reduce the consistency and strong correlation among pixels and enhance the security of encrypted image data, this bit-level image encryption algorithm utilizes chaotic mapping. The structure of the algorithm is two disruptions and two diffusions: firstly, the image is disrupted by Arnold chaotic mapping; secondly, the image is processed in chunks, and if there is still strong correlation or consistency between the pixels in the chunks, the pixels of the original image are diffused by combining the coordinate information and logistic chaos. For pixel blocks that have already been processed or do not have strong correlation or consistency, image pixel disambiguation and diffusion are accomplished simultaneously by logistic chaotic mapping and bit-level positional permutation. Finally, S-boxes are introduced to further diffuse the image. By verifying the experimental results, the method in this paper is highly secure and resistant to common attacks.

articleTitle: Image Tampering Detection Method Based on Dilated Convolution
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Image tampering is a common digital image processing technique that involves modifying original images through operations such as copying, cutting, pasting, and blending, with the aim of deceiving or falsifying information. With the rapid development of digital imaging technology and deep learning, image tampering detection has become a crucial research field. To address this issue, this paper proposes an image tampering detection method based on dilated convolution and anomaly feature extraction. The method introduces dilated convolutions to increase the network's receptive field and utilizes anomaly feature extraction to identify and pinpoint areas of anomaly in tampered images. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves good performance on different test datasets, indicating promising applications in practice.

articleTitle: Algorithm for EEG Signal Recognition Based on Unsupervised Pretraining and Transformer Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This article proposes a Vision Transformer network based on pre-trained ResNet, a convolutional neural network, for automatic recognition of epilepsy EEG signals. An autoencoder model is constructed for unsupervised pre-training, obtaining weights on an unlabeled dataset. This approach differs from the lengthy and complex training of recurrent neural networks and multilayer perceptrons. ResNet, as a classic convolutional neural network, possesses strong feature learning capabilities for input data like images. Through unsupervised pre-training, ResNet can extract informative representations from large-scale unlabeled data, which helps improve the performance of subsequent classification tasks. EEG signals are time series data that require more modeling of temporal correlations compared to fixed-size inputs like images. EEG signals typically exhibit long-term temporal dependencies, and Transformers, through self-attention mechanisms, can capture long-range dependencies in time. Compared to recurrent neural networks and multilayer perceptrons, Transformer-based networks can better model global relationships in sequential data, thereby enhancing classification performance. Unsupervised pre-training eliminates the need for data annotation, greatly reducing manual labeling efforts. After the pre-training phase, the pre-trained weights are saved as the initial weights for the subsequent network. A neural network based on Vision Transformer attention is constructed to enhance the network's feature extraction and learning capabilities. The pre-trained weights are iteratively fine-tuned, combining both steps. This approach accelerates the training and convergence speed of the Vision Transformer network, reduces computational costs, and improves the accuracy of the final classification results. Compared to other models such as LSTM, CNN, and SVM, various performance metrics show significant improvements.

articleTitle: Semantic Query Technology for Academic Planning Service System Based on Comparative Learning Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This research paper focuses on exploring the utilization of semantic query technology to enhance the academic planning service system, thereby effectively addressing the information retrieval requirements of students. By leveraging advanced semantic query techniques, the study aims to optimize the functionality and user experience of the service system, ensuring that students can access relevant and accurate information seamlessly. The ultimate goal is to bridge the existing gaps in the academic planning process and provide an efficient and tailored solution that aligns with the specific needs of students. The semantic query method based on contrastive learning constructed in this paper mainly includes three modules, constraint condition recognition, semantic similarity calculation and query sentence generation, and uses contrastive learning to optimize the traditional intent recognition task. The ESimCSE model based on contrastive learning is used to extract the semantic feature vector of the query sentence, and the best intent type is selected by calculating the cosine similarity to complete the intent recognition task. The experiment shows that the use of ESimCSE model for intent recognition has achieved good results. Finally, the query accuracy of the system reaches 96.2%.

articleTitle: Method for Assisting in the Selection of Shared Bicycle Deployment Points Based on Multi-Source Data Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This study proposes a novel method for assisting in the selection of shared bicycle deployment points, optimized using multi-source data. The method integrates a diverse dataset that includes user travel demand, road traffic elements, and geographic information, with a special emphasis on enhancing deployment strategies through the aggregation of user demands. It employs a displacement method to adjust deployment locations, addressing the dynamic nature of urban traffic and achieving an optimal balance between system efficiency and user demand satisfaction. The integration of multi-source data and the application of discrete optimization techniques significantly enhance the operational efficiency and user experience of the shared bicycle system. This work offers new perspectives for the future development of urban intelligent transportation, demonstrating the potential of data-driven strategies in solving urban traffic challenges.

articleTitle: Talent Recommendation Algorithm Integrating Knowledge Grap
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Due to the limitations of traditional recommendation algorithms in considering semantic information and achieving high precision in talent recommendation for cadre team construction, this paper proposes a talent recommendation algorithm called TransR-CF. This algorithm integrates a knowledge graph and a collaborative filtering algorithm. By constructing a knowledge graph of employee information and incorporating semantic information among employees as a key recommendation factor, the TransR translation model is used to learn knowledge representation and map the employee knowledge graph to a lower-dimensional continuous vector space, capturing entities and their relationships. Semantic similarity between employees is then calculated and linearly combined with behavior similarity derived from the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm. This algorithm takes into account semantic information while building upon the traditional collaborative filtering approach, mitigating the impact of data sparsity and cold start issues on recommendation results, and improving the reliability and precision of recommendations. Experimental results on a personnel information dataset from a power enterprise's cadre team construction system demonstrate that this algorithm achieves a significant improvement in precision, recall, and F-value compared to the benchmark algorithm.

articleTitle: An Imbalance Data Oriented Approach to Enterprise Tax Risk Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Along with the continuous development of information technology, higher requirements have been put forward for the tax risk management ability of tax departments. In the context of tax big data, the serious data imbalance problem has increased the difficulty of analyzing enterprise tax risk. This paper proposes an enterprise tax risk prediction method for imbalance data to address the data imbalance problem in the process of analyzing the tax risk of enterprise purchases and sales invoice data. The method adopts intelligent analysis methods such as imbalance data balancing processing and integrated learning in the field of machine learning to provide a solution to the problem of enterprise tax risk prediction in the environment of tax big data. In comparison with other several algorithms, the proposed method achieves a certain degree of improvement in terms of accuracy, precision and F1-measure, which is an effective and feasible method for predicting tax risk.

articleTitle: Application and Optimization of Micro/Nano Electronic Sensors Based on Deep Learning in Human-Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The exponential growth of population and the use of electronic and electrical equipment have increased the requirement for energy production management, thereby increasing the need for precise energy management systems that can predict consumer use for future policy formulation. MEMS/NEMS technology, as a mature microstructure manufacturing technology, can form micro sensors and testing systems with small volume, light weight, and high performance. To improve the human-machine interaction experience of smart grids, this article applies micro/nano sensor technology to human-machine interaction optimization and proposes a data fusion model based on deep learning (DL). Based on the principle structure and training method of Deep Neural Network (DNN), a multi-source data system for power grid technical renovation projects has been constructed, which includes technical factors, economic factors, and environmental factors. This system can effectively analyze energy usage and combine multi-source data fusion technology to achieve intelligent evaluation of power grid projects. The experimental results show that the model designed in this paper is effective and superior, and has reference significance for improving the data fusion algorithm of micro and nano sensors in big data environments.

articleTitle: Harnessing BERT and CNN Synergy for Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, a critical subfield of Natural Language Processing (NLP), focuses on the identification and categorization of sentiments, opinions, and emotions from text. This subfield is quintessential in elucidating the subjective nuances of linguistic expression and has been the subject of considerable scholarly inquiry, attributed to its profound impact across a diverse array of sectors including, but not limited to, marketing, political science, and customer service. In this paper, we present a hybrid model that integrates the semantic understanding capabilities of BERT with the pattern recognition strengths of a CNN for enhanced sentiment classification. Our model utilizes BERT's advanced capability for generating deep semantic representations of lexical items, effectively harnessing contextual interdependencies within textual data. BERT produces a contextualized embedding for each token in the input text. Subsequently, these embedding vectors are fed into CNN, which refines feature extraction for sentiment classification. Our evaluation on the Stanford Sentiment Treebank-2 (SST-2) dataset shows that the BERT-CNN model substantially surpasses the performance of BERT alone, achieving an accuracy of 92.15%. This improvement highlights the potential of hybrid models in advancing the accuracy of sentiment analysis applications.

articleTitle: Research on Workpiece Recognition Algorithm based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In industrial production environments, object recognition for workpieces is confronted with complex scenarios involving varying lighting conditions and diverse orientations, factors that significantly impact the performance of traditional object detection algorithms, leading to decreased accuracy and inadequate robustness. To tackle this issue, this study proposes a novel optimization scheme based on Faster R-CNN. Firstly, ResNet-50 is used to replace the original feature extraction network VGG16. This improvement effectively improves the feature extraction ability of the model under complex lighting conditions and different placement states, and reduces the calculation cost. In addition, SENet attention module and CBAM attention mechanism are introduced to enhance the recognition robustness of key features of illumination and position. SENet learns to adaptively weight each feature channel, enabling the model to focus selectively on light- and position-sensitive key information. Concurrently, CBAM integrates channel and spatial attentions to more precisely capture salient features of the workpiece within the image. Experiments were conducted using a publicly available dataset, simulating normal, bright, and dim lighting conditions. A comprehensive dataset was constructed through a series of data augmentation techniques. The experimental results demonstrated that the improved algorithmic model exhibits superior performance across evaluation metrics, thereby substantiating the effectiveness of the proposed enhancements.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Thermal Error Compensation Method for CNC Machine Tool Electric Spindle
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The thermal error of CNC machine tools has consistently been a prominent and significant subject of interest within the realm of mechanical manufacturing. The decrease in machining accuracy caused by thermal errors affects the entire machine tool manufacturing industry. In particular, for CNC machine tools equipped with high-speed electric spindles, the thermal deformation of the electric spindle has a direct impact on the machining quality of the machine tool. This paper proposes a thermal error prediction model and designs a thermal error compensation method specifically for electric spindles. The designed method is then validated through workpiece machining experiments on a CNC machine tool equipped with a high-speed electric spindle. The experimental findings substantiate that implementing the approach presented in this paper for thermal error compensation of the electric spindle leads to a substantial enhancement in the accuracy of the machined workpieces. The effectiveness of the methodology outlined in this paper for addressing the thermal error problem in machine tool electric spindles is confirmed.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Electricity Regulatory Technology for Pollution Sources in Northern Industrial Aggregation Sites
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This paper takes the pollution sources of a fluorine industry agglomeration in the north as the research object, combines the current environmental protection policy and the actual needs of environmental management, puts forward a new platform construction technology concept based on "environmental protection Internet of things + environmental protection data center +", combines a proposed state-space based power consumption model and a CNN-BiLSTM Combined with a proposed state-space-based power consumption model and a CNN-BiLSTM multi-feature classification prediction algorithm, a set of intelligent, informatized and visualized platform for intelligent supervision of power consumption by pollutants in the northern industrial agglomerations is developed. The results show that the platform successfully realizes the goals of fine control of electricity consumption of pollution sources and reduction of energy waste. The results of this study provide a scientific and effective solution to the problem of pollution source regulation in northern industrial clusters.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Machine Vision: Advanced Convolutional Strategies for Rapid Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive examination of innovative strategies aimed at enhancing machine vision technology, particularly in the context of energy efficiency and processing speed, critical factors for applications like facial recognition. The study focuses on three distinct approaches: an optimized two-dimensional convolution algorithm, a novel Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) implementation, and advancements in multichannel meta-imagers. Firstly, the paper discusses an optimized algorithm for two-dimensional convolutions, a fundamental operation in machine vision. This advanced algorithm significantly reduces computational complexity. For instance, in executing a two-dimensional 3×3 cyclic convolution, the proposed method reduces the number of necessary multiplications from 81 to merely 13, offering a substantial improvement in efficiency. Secondly, the paper explores an innovative FPGA implementation of the two-dimensional convolution algorithm. This implementation is designed to minimize the use of shift registers, multipliers, and adders. As a result, it utilizes fewer Look-Up Tables (LUTs), leading to energy and time savings in executing the convolution process. The paper details the architecture of this FPGA-based approach and its implications for energy consumption and processing speed in machine vision applications. Finally, the paper introduces a novel technique called the Avg-Topk method, addressing a critical challenge in the pooling layer of convolutional neural networks. This method combines the benefits of average pooling with the advantages of max pooling, aiming to enhance the accuracy of the pooling layer without compromising on efficiency. The Avg-Topk method represents a significant step forward in optimizing the pooling process within machine vision systems. In summary, this paper delves into groundbreaking methods to improve the speed and energy efficiency of machine vision systems, offering valuable insights and potential solutions for the advancement of this rapidly evolving field.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Multi-Sensor Track Association Method based on Improved TCN-ResNet
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The problem of track association in multi-sensor target tracking is a challenging aspect. Addressing the issues of poor generalization, complex processes, and the time-consuming nature of recurrent neural networks, an improved approach was developed based on the traditional TCN network. By utilizing the TCN network, this approach rapidly and efficiently extracts temporal features in parallel. Additionally, the powerful spatial feature extraction capability of ResNet is incorporated. This proposed method, known as the improved TCN-ResNet neural network for track association, demonstrates promising results. Monte Carlo simulation experiments revealed a track association accuracy of 94.64% using this algorithm. In comparison to feature extraction methods utilizing recurrent neural networks, the time efficiency was improved by 60.86%. This presents a novel solution for the multi-sensor track association problem.

articleTitle: Quantitative Prediction of Axis Alignment Based on Magnetic Flux Leakage Detection and GA-BP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In solving the problem of shaft alignment detection, traditional shaft alignment methods such as the gauge method, double table method, and laser method can detect shaft alignment in engineering. However, there are still problems with low accuracy and cumbersome detection steps in traditional shaft alignment detection. In order to improve the accuracy of axis alignment detection and simplify the tedious steps of axis alignment detection, we propose a new method based on the combination of magnetic flux leakage detection and artificial neural network. Firstly, by using the grey correlation analysis method in data feature correlation, the features that have a significant impact on the leakage magnetic flux data of the axial alignment model are selected, and a negative feedback neural network model is established for prediction. In order to solve the problem of traditional BP neural networks randomly selecting thresholds and easily falling into local optima, we introduced a genetic algorithm to optimize the random threshold of BP neural networks and improve the prediction accuracy of nonlinear problems and the global search ability of the algorithm. The experimental results show that our proposed method can significantly improve the detection accuracy of axis alignment and effectively achieve quantitative detection of axis alignment based on magnetic flux leakage detection.

articleTitle: Research on The Layout Optimization Problem of Computational Power Network (CPN) Based on Greedy Algorithm and QUBO Model
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: To address the problem, we need to deploy two edge servers in a specific area to maximize the computational demand of the coverage. The problem can be transformed into a maximum coverage problem where the goal is to select a set of locations to deploy edge servers such that the total computational demand being covered is maximized. To solve this problem, we use a greedy algorithm. For quantum computing, the problem can be modeled as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem. The solution process involves calculating the coverage area and computational requirements of possible server locations, constructing a QUBO model, solving the model using a solver and simulator, and parsing the results to obtain the optimal server deployment locations. The final result is the coordinate locations of the edge servers with optimized coverage of computational demands and the corresponding amount of coverage computational demands.

articleTitle: Technical Research and Application Analysis of Multimodal Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In the digital era, social software has become integral to everyday life and work, serving as platforms for users to share content and interact. The personal opinions and emotions embedded in these interactions significantly impact the real world, shaping trends and opinions. This backdrop has catapulted emotion recognition into a critical research area within artificial intelligence. Traditional monomodal emotion recognition often falls short in accurately predicting user emotions, paving the way for multimodal emotion recognition. This approach, leveraging a comprehensive analysis of voice, visual, and textual data, offers a more nuanced understanding of human emotions. This paper explores the pivotal technologies, system applications, challenges, and future directions of multimodal emotion recognition. It begins by introducing the concept and significance of multimodal emotion recognition in AI. The subsequent section delves into data processing, encompassing the collection and integration of multimodal data, and examining how these processes affect emotion recognition accuracy. The third section reviews algorithms and models in multimodal emotion recognition, discussing the advancements and hurdles in modal fusion technology. Case studies illustrate the impact of these technologies in practical scenarios. The final section outlines the primary challenges, future trends, and potential research avenues in multimodal emotion recognition technology.

articleTitle: Application of Inverse Text Normalization Technology in Power Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In the field of power dispatching, there is a substantial amount of textual information, including instructions and operation tickets. Recording and preserving this information is often done manually, resulting in low work efficiency and inconsistent text formatting, leading to poor readability. This paper proposes the application of ITN (Inverse Text Normalization) technology in power dispatching, which involves an additional layer of transformation on the original speech recognition results. It transforms spoken language into text format according to the grammar rules specific to power dispatching, making it more aligned with industry personnel's reading habits. This, in turn, enhances the efficiency of dispatch information preservation and text readability.

articleTitle: Depth Estimation Method for Monocular Images Combined with Position Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a monocular image depth estimation method based on ResNet and bitmap estimation. Traditional monocular depth estimation methods usually utilize convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for end-to-end training, but often require large amounts of labeled data. To overcome the problem of difficult data labeling, we use a competitive cooperative learning approach to jointly train depth estimation networks, camera motion estimation, optical flow estimation, and motion segmentation networks. We use ResNet as the backbone network for depth estimation, which achieves efficient feature transfer through residual concatenation. In addition, we introduce a bit-position estimation module to assist the depth estimation task by estimating camera motion and bit-position information. Experimental results show that our proposed method achieves good performance in the monocular depth estimation task and still achieves satisfactory results in the absence of labeled data.

articleTitle: Biogas Fermentation Monitoring Research Based on Borderline-SMOTE Algorithm and Stacking Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Anaerobic fermentation is the most important link to gas production, this paper solves the current problem with the help of the current complete machine learning technology, combining perception and intelligent processing, intelligent processing of information, and derive a decision-making basis for its control or management [1]. Aiming at the current problems of the anaerobic fermentation process in biogas engineering, the system design was carried out, and the anaerobic fermentation process of biogas and its main influencing factors were investigated, and the monitoring parameters of the system were selected to be temperature, PH value, liquid level and redox potential [2]. Previous studies are mainly based on a single prediction model, which leads to poor generalization ability of the model. In this study, unbalanced samples are handled by Borderline-SMOTE algorithm. Based on the Stacking integrated learning approach, a common single prediction model is used to construct a combined prediction model. The accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score and area under the ROC curve are used to evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of the combined prediction model over the single prediction model.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Wind Power Consumption Capacity Based on Multi-Objective Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
