abstract: Due to the increasing wind permeability, it has become more important for wind power to contribute to the country's power generation capacity. This paper presents an evaluation method that aims to optimize the consumption capacity of wind power. Firstly, a multi-objective optimal scheduling model of power system including wind power was established with the goals of minimizing power generation costs, minimizing pollutant emissions, and increasing wind power consumption capacity. Then, after analysis, we consider introducing random simulation technology to improve the initial population, and modify the traditional crossover operator in NSGA2 into a binary crossover operator. Based on this, an improved NSGA2 algorithm is proposed. Finally, the IEEE 118-node system is considered as a case of multi-objective optimization to solve and test the optimal wind power consumption capacity of the grid, and the simulation results demonstrate the viability of the suggested approach.

articleTitle: Research on Reinforcement Learning Algorithm for Dynamic Congestion Control of Power Internet of Things in Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the continuous development of Internet of Things (IoT), dynamic congestion control of power system has become an important issue to ensure the stability of the system. Aiming at the complex environment, this study proposes and studies a Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm based on Double depth Q network (DDQN) for dynamic congestion control of power IoT. Through the experimental verification on comprehensive data sets, we deeply discuss the performance of the algorithm in complex environment. In the experiment, the mathematical model of power system is constructed, and the key elements such as state, action and reward are clearly defined, and DDQN is used for RL. The research results show that the algorithm based on DDQN can adaptively learn the dynamic congestion control strategy of power system, and has achieved remarkable performance improvement in complex environment. In addition, the algorithm performs well for high-dimensional and large-scale data processing, showing its potential application value in power IoT environment. This study introduces a novel RL algorithm to the field of power IoT dynamic congestion control, and provides an effective solution for intelligent management of power system. This is of great theoretical and practical significance for improving the operation efficiency and stability of power system and promoting the development of power IoT technology.

articleTitle: Air Quality Level Detection Based on Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Traditional air quality detection methods rely too much on high-precision instruments, which are costly and inflexible. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an image recognition-based air quality level detection method, which detects the air quality level by acquiring the scene image information to reduce the dependence on instruments and realize the fine-grained air quality level assessment. In this paper, ResNet18 is used as the base model, and the improved residual module and GeLU function are introduced to improve the feature expression ability and nonlinear fitting ability of the model, and finally, the model’s attention to the important channel information is enhanced by adding the ParNet-Attention attention mechanism. By constructing an air quality image information base and conducting comparative analysis, the experimental results show that the accuracy of the air quality level detection model based on image recognition proposed in this paper is up to 90.65%, which is 2.86% and 0.96% higher than that of the ResNet18 (87.79%) and ConvNext-Tiny (89.69%) with excellent performance, and the number of parameters is 21.68% lower than that of ParNet-Attention, respectively. The number of parameters is reduced by 21.68% and 67.97%, which effectively improves the detection accuracy and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors Based on NARX Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The internal parameters of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSMs), such as stator resistance, inductance, can vary with the change in working load. This inevitably affects the control performance and accuracy of the motor. Therefore, implementing online parameter identification for the motor is essential to achieve precise control. In this paper, a parameter identification method based on NARX neural network is proposed for online identification of d-axis and q-axis inductance, stator resistance, and rotor permanent magnet flux of PMSMs. Finally, the accuracy and correctness of the proposed method are verified through simulations, demonstrating its effectiveness in motor parameter identification.

articleTitle: A Simulation and Optimization Method for Machine Tool Motion Trajectory Based on Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that sudden changes in velocity and acceleration at the corners of adjacent segments during high-speed machining of tiny line segments can lead to motor vibration and tool over-cutting, a machine trajectory monitoring and optimization method based on digital twin simulation and adaptive local polynomial interpolation algorithm is proposed. The digital twin simulation system is set up to monitor the trajectory and speed of the machine tool during machining, and the adaptive fifth degree polynomial is used to fit the corner trajectory when there is a sudden change of speed or acceleration at the corner of the machining trajectory, and then the curve interpolation is carried out by using the fitted curves, so as to improve the stability and accuracy of machining. In the experiment, a digital twin simulation system is established based on four elements of the Agent, and then the runtime data of the physical machine tool is collected through the protocol. Finally, the trajectory is optimized using the polynomial interpolation algorithm. A digital twin simulation system for Turn-milling machines is established to validate the functionality

articleTitle: Innovative Approaches to Long-term Power Load Forecasting with Autoformer
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The significance of long-term power load forecasting stems from its profound impact on power system operation and planning, allocation of energy resources, and the overall stability of the social economy. Electric power load is influenced by various factors, including seasonal variations, meteorological conditions, technological advancements, among others. These intertwined factors render long-term load forecasting a complex task characterized by heightened uncertainty. While most existing methods primarily focus on short-term power load forecasting, there is presently a lack of effective approaches for addressing long-term power load forecasting challenges. To tackle this issue, this study uses the Autoformer model for long-term power load forecasting, and uses the Pearson model and random forest to explore the correlation between variables for the correlation degree between each characteristic variable and the power load. The research findings demonstrate that the Autoformer model outperforms other models, delivering the most accurate predictions with the lowest error values.

articleTitle: Contactless Radar Vital Signs Detection based on VMD Combined IWTD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Vital signs monitoring is critical in the field of smart healthcare. However, the detection of millimeter wave radar for contactless vital sign detection is often affected by random body movement. Furthermore, the amplitude of respiratory is significantly greater than that of cardiac. As a result, the cardiac signal is frequently disrupted by clutter and respiratory harmonics. In this paper, a novel approach for vital signs detection has been developed to overcome these problems. It is based on an existing signal decomposition algorithm and wavelet threshold denoising algorithm. Firstly, the signal is decomposed by Variational Modal Decomposition (VMD) method and a series of modal components are obtained, the modal components corresponding to respiration and cardiac signals are selected. Then, the respiratory and cardiac signals are denoised with Improved Wavelet Threshold Denoising (IWTD) method. Finally, the efficiency of this approach is confirmed through simulation. Results show that this algorithm outperforms traditional wavelet threshold function method in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) situations.

articleTitle: A Method for CNC Machining Trajectory Compression Based on Deep Q-Network (DQN)
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low data transmission efficiency, ample storage space required, and performance degradation when executing G-code caused by the massive small segment machining code (G01 code) of CNC system, a data compression method of CNC system machining G01 code based on deep Q network (DQN) was proposed. This method first parses the G01 machining data program of the CNC system into a 3D data point sequence, treats the data compression process as a sequential decision problem, and uses the DQN method to learn the sequence decision problem to achieve data compression. It can also achieve adaptive adjustment of the compression rate by adjusting the algorithm parameters of the DQN, which has the advantages of high compression efficiency and fast execution speed. At the end of the paper, an experimental case is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method by selecting key points in the G-code file of lamp cover modeling.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of CNC Handheld Device Based on PROFINET
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the arrival of Industry 4.0, CNC machine tools, one of the important development goals of industry, are gradually developing towards openness. As a mainstream automation bus standard, Industrial Ethernet PROFINET is compatible with Ethernet technology and other buses. It has the characteristics of high performance, high efficiency, flexibility and openness, providing an excellent open solution for CNC systems. On the basis of analyzing the principle of PROFINET device protocol, combined with the theory of hardware and software co-design, the dual-core structure of Siemens ERTEC200P-2 parsing protocols and ARM chip development peripherals was used to carry out the hardware and software design and development of the CNC hand-held operating station, and the functions of the CNC hand-held operating station were realized. The verification is completed through the consistency of the host computer program data and the CNC handheld device data.

articleTitle: Automatic Integration Method for Multi-source Communication Data Based on Graph Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: To address the problems of the complex communication resource data types, long processing and transmission time, and low data coverage in the integration process, this paper designs an automatic integration method for multi-source communication data based on graph deep learning. First, according to the communication resource data attributes and interaction relationship to develop communication resource data classification standards, to achieve the same source data division to improve the integration efficiency. Then, we design the multi-source data-coding standard based on zero code, and associate the communication data types to improve the retrieval efficiency. Finally, the node matrix updating method based on graph convolution is proposed to extract the discrete data of nodes to achieve the integration of communication resources by combining multi-source data. The experiment proves that this data integration method can effectively improve the efficiency of multi-source communication data utilization with a data coverage rate as high as 85% and an integration time reduction of 56%.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Method and Application of Personalized Learner Portraits Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the rapid development of educational technology, personalized learning has become a key way to improve educational effectiveness. This study uses machine learning technology to construct learner portraits and applies it to the optimization of personalized recommendation systems and teaching strategies. Through detailed experimental design and rigorous data analysis, the research shows that personalized learner portraits can effectively improve the accuracy of recommendation systems and the level of personalization of teaching content. The study adopted a variety of data preprocessing and feature engineering techniques to ensure data quality and feature effectiveness. In addition, by comparing the performance of different machine learning algorithms, this study determined the optimal model, implemented it in actual teaching scenarios, and evaluated the effect of the system through online experiments and user surveys. The results show that personalized recommendations significantly improve learner engagement and learning effectiveness. Although the research has achieved certain results, there are still problems such as the scope of data collection and sample size limitations. Future research can expand the data set, adopt advanced algorithms, and deeply explore the broad application of learner profiling in teaching practice.

articleTitle: Forest Fire Detection and Analysis Based on Joint MLP and CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Preventing forest fires is crucial to ecological protection and human social security. This paper focuses on using machine learning methods to accurately classify forest fire and non-fire scene images, thereby providing technical support for early fire detection. This study builds and compares two mainstream machine learning models, Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) model and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) model, and uses a variety of techniques to optimize the models. The experiment carries out a series of pre-processing techniques on the images and unify the image sizes. The MLP model is combined with transfer learning. The trained model performed well. To explore a better model, a CNN model is built. The model training results after data enhancement Performance meets expectations. After systematic experimental verification, although the accuracy of the two models is relatively close, the CNN model shows better performance in terms of convergence speed and model robustness and is therefore more suitable for this type of image classification task. This research not only provides new algorithmic strategies for fire detection systems but also provides a useful reference for the application of machine learning in the field of natural disaster prevention and control. By effectively identifying potential fire scenarios, this research has important practical implications for improving forest protection and reducing fire losses.

articleTitle: Dual Domain Adaptive Distributed Photovoltaic Output Prediction Method Based on GNN
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low accuracy of existing distributed photovoltaic prediction methods and uncertainty changes in photovoltaic data, a dual-domain adaptive distributed photovoltaic output prediction method based on graph neural network (GNN) is proposed to achieve high-precision prediction of distributed photovoltaic output. Many existing methods ignore the spatial correlation between distributed PV devices or use static graph neural networks, which limits flexibility and has high data requirements leading to poor performance. This article innovatively combines the two branches of graph convolutional neural network, spatial domain and spectral domain, relies on photovoltaic equipment coordinates to construct a graph structure, and uses dynamic adaptive adjacency matrix and static distance adjacency matrix to capture global and local spatial correlation respectively to mine photovoltaic output. Spatial features between data, bidirectional gated recurrent neural network and attention mechanism are used to extract temporal features, and the spatio-temporal features are combined for photovoltaic output prediction. Compared with existing methods, the accuracy of this method is improved by about 7.03% on average.

articleTitle: Research on Link Prediction Based on Belmanfort Neural Network Integrating Personalized Pagerank Algorithm and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Knowledge graphs are widely used in information retrieval, natural language understanding, recommendation systems and other fields with their powerful knowledge expression capabilities. However, the incompleteness of the knowledge graph will bring about problems such as incomplete search results, insufficient accuracy, and limited application fields, making link prediction an important method to expand and improve the knowledge graph. The Bellman-Ford neural network is a general and flexible path-based knowledge representation learning framework. It can be applied to implement the link prediction tasks of homogeneous graphs and knowledge graphs. The model performance is better than the previous method. This paper introduces a model named PPAR-NBFNet to implement link prediction task in knowledge graph. First, the model uses the embedding method to initialize the entities and relationships into embedding vectors. Then the embedding vector is input into the Bellman-Ford neural network. Replace the operators in the formula with the graph attention network and multi-aggregator that integrate the personalized PageRank algorithm, which can convert the generalized Bellman-Ford formula into a Bellman-Ford neural network, and embed the input entities and relationships into vectors. Feature representation of the entity pair. Finally, a multi-perceptron model is used as a scoring function to assign a score to each possible triplet of the entity pair as the probability score of appearing as a real triplet. The experiment was verified on the public data set FB15K-237, and was better than the Bellman-Ford neural network model in three evaluation indicators: MR, MRR, and Hist ranking.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithm Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: We propose the Deep-INTN-NGCF algorithm, which is an innovative recommendation algorithm that solves the problem of modelling relationships that exists in graph neural network based recommendation algorithms, which aims to solve the smoothing problem and the problem of ignoring fine-grained interaction intent in traditional collaborative filtering methods. The algorithm combines the ideas of deep graph neural networks and interaction intent modelling. In order to avoid the problem of graph neural networks falling into oversmoothing after performing multiple graph convolution operations, the Deep-INTN-NGCF algorithm employs initial residual connectivity and constant mapping. The initial embeddings of users and items are obtained through their interaction history. In the aggregation propagation layer, the initial residual connection and constant mapping are used to fuse the different orders of synergistic signals of users and items, and the predicted scores are obtained through linear representation. By adjusting the weights in the initial residual connection and constant mapping, the flexibility and recommendation performance of the model can be improved. In addition, the Deep-INTN-NGCF algorithm introduces fine-grained modelling of interaction intentions, in order to identify potential intentions and determine their importance, in order to solve this problem, we adopt the method of decomposing edges into multiple potential spaces and combine it with an interaction intention fusion layer. Ultimately, the user's predicted score for the item is generated. Experiments demonstrate that the Deep-INTN-NGCF algorithm performs well on the Gowalla, Yelp-2018, and Amazon-Book datasets, with higher recall and normalised discount cumulative gain (NDCG) than existing graph neural network recommendation algorithms. This validates the effectiveness and performance benefits of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Tool Wear Feature Extraction and Result Prediction Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In the process of CNC machining, timely and accurate diagnosis and prediction of tool wear faults are crucial for maintaining the reliability of CNC machine tools. To address the issues of information loss and concentration in traditional feature extraction methods in the field of tool wear prediction, a multi-modal fusion feature extraction method is proposed for tool wear prediction. Firstly, comprehensive features are extracted from multi-sensor signals within the tool state monitoring framework, and the raw signals are processed using the third quartile and Hampel filtering. Finally, to validate the effectiveness of feature extraction, support vector machines, random forests, and deep neural networks are employed to handle time-domain, frequency-domain, and joint time-frequency domain features, respectively, to establish tool wear prediction models. The performance of the prediction models is evaluated using metrics such as root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE). The results verify the effectiveness of the feature extraction method. Experimental results demonstrate that using this method for feature extraction can effectively enhance the accuracy of prediction models, facilitating real-time monitoring of tool wear under normal production conditions.

articleTitle: Wind Speed Prediction Method Based on EMD-LSTM with Integrated Spatial Features
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In urban wind speed prediction, when forecasting wind speed at a single station, it is crucial to take into account the impact of wind speeds at surrounding monitoring stations. To address this issue, a wind speed forecasting approach utilizing Empirical Mode Decomposition-Long Short-Term Memory (EMD-LSTM) with integrated spatial features is proposed. This method employs Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) to decompose wind speed data in the time model. Subsequently, multiple LSTM models are applied to predict each decomposed component, and their predictions are aggregated to formulate the wind speed forecast, utilizing temporal features. In the spatial model, vector decomposition and interpolation of wind speeds at nearby stations are performed. The spatial independence weights are determined by calculating the distance between the interpolated results and actual values. Finally, in the model fusion stage, Bayesian optimization of weights is conducted based on spatial independence, resulting in the prediction of wind speed values that integrate both temporal and spatial features. Experimental findings suggest that the proposed model, considering both time and space features, achieves an average absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 20.661% for wind speed prediction and 22.038% for wind direction prediction, demonstrating relatively high accuracy. Additionally, the model exhibits a mean absolute error (MAE) of 7% and a root mean square error (RMSE) of 16%, effectively enhancing the precision of wind speed forecasting in comparison to LSTM.

articleTitle: A Stacking-Based VOCs Emission Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: VOCs (Volatile Organic Compounds) monitoring plays an important role in air pollution prevention. However, many factories are not yet equipped with VOCs monitoring equipment, or are equipped but lack effective methods for predicting VOCs. This results in regulators not being able to detect whether a factory is emitting VOCs above the limit in time, which can trigger air pollution and cause damage to human health. Fortunately, with the rapid advances in artificial intelligence and machine learning, we are able to apply these leading techniques to solve the VOCS emission prediction problem. In this paper, based on these AI and machine learning theories, we propose a stacked integrated learning method utilizing multi-model fusion for VOCs prediction. The method fully exploits the advantages of different algorithms in different contexts and establishes a VOCs prediction model that integrates multiple machine learning algorithms. The model employs several base learners such as SVR, Random Forest, GBDT, LightGBM and XGBoost. In terms of data processing, steps such as missing value filling, outlier detection and data transformation were performed. Meanwhile, operations such as feature construction and feature selection were performed to improve the prediction performance in combination with business scenarios. In order to de-verify the feasibility of the algorithm, this paper empirically analyzes the VOCs monitoring data of a chemical park as an example. The results show that the stakcing-based VOCs prediction method has higher prediction accuracy compared with the single machine learning model prediction, which proves the feasibility of the method in this paper. By fully utilizing the advantages of multiple machine learning algorithms, the model is able to predict VOCs emissions more accurately. This study provides a new way to solve the problem of VOCs emission prediction and provides regulators with more effective tools to protect the environment and human health.

articleTitle: Multimodal Anti-Spoofing Emotion Recognition Using GRU and BERT
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Accurate recognition of human emotions is crucial for enhancing the effectiveness of human-computer interactions. This study addresses the limitations associated with using single-modal physiological signals by proposing a novel multimodal anti-spoofing emotion recognition model (MABer). The model integrates electroencephalogram (EEG), facial expression images, and heart rate signals, leveraging their complementary nature. It extracts temporal and spectral signatures from physiological signals by employing a bidirectional gated recurrent unit (GRU). Additionally, an asymmetric Transformer architecture is utilized for enhanced feature fusion and learning. The proposed model achieves superior performance when compared to existing methods, as demonstrated on the DEAP dataset. This study proposes a robust framework for identifying multimodal emotions based on physiological signals, facilitating the development of anti-spoofing intelligent human-computer interaction systems.

articleTitle: GS-PBFT: A Practical Byzantine Consensus Algorithm Based on Scoring Mechanism and Stake Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance Algorithm (PBFT) can improve efficiency on the basis of the original algorithm, but there are still some issues such as high algorithm complexity, arbitrary decision of primary nodes, and poor scalability. In order to solve these issues, this paper proposes an optimized algorithm GS-PBFT based on the scoring mechanism and the stake mechanism. GS-PBFT first groups the nodes, and the primary nodes in the group also need to participate in the consensus outside the group. Secondly, a scoring mechanism is proposed to score nodes based on whether they can correctly finish the consensus and the efficiency of taking part in consensus. Malicious nodes can be identified and eliminated, and nodes that are unable to participate in consensus due to downtime can be quickly restored. Finally, a stake mechanism is proposed to improve the active nodes' weight, thereby accelerating overall efficiency. Simulation experiments show that compared with the original algorithm, the GS-PBFT algorithm proposed in this paper has greatly improved efficiency, tolerance of malicious nodes, and throughput indicators.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Unordered Grasping System for Stacked Workpieces Based on 3D Vision System
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Object pose estimation is a key technology for robotic arms to achieve three-dimensional object picking in a scattered environment, and most current pose estimation algorithms require the detected object to be placed in a simple environment for study. Although this method simplifies the task of locating objects, it also means that they have limited object positioning performance in complex environments. Aiming at the problem of lack of target feature information and large pose estimation error caused by dense stacking of workpieces in disordered sorting scenarios, this paper proposes a method combining deep learning and point cloud registration, and designs a robotic arm gripping system to complete the grasping of scattered stacked workpieces. Experimental results on the simulation dataset and the real data set show that the proposed method can not only accurately identify the scattered stacked workpieces, but also quickly and accurately calculate their 6D pose and successfully grasp them through the robotic arm.

articleTitle: DW-YOLOv5: An Improved Teeth Instance Segmentation with Dyhead and Wise- IoU
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The aim of the research is to implement teeth instance segmentation in oral and maxillofacial images using deep learning techniques. An enhanced YOLOv5-seg model is proposed, which replaces standard convolutions with Deformable Convolution within the YOLOv5-seg framework. This substitution aims to boost the network's feature extraction capabilities. Additionally, a dynamic head (dyhead), an adaptive attention mechanism, is introduced to capture information more effectively, improving tooth saliency and segmentation accuracy in images. The Wise-IoU metric is introduced as an evaluation benchmark, enhancing the comprehensive and reliable assessment of model performance. Notably, traditional image augmentation methods, such as rotation and flipping, are omitted due to the unique nature of dental images. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved YOLOv5-seg instance segmentation model achieves an mAP of 88.5% on a custom oral and maxillofacial image dataset, indicating its enhanced suitability for teeth segmentation tasks.

articleTitle: Application of Ensemble Learning Model in Predicting Gestational diabetes
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Gestational diabetes Mellitus (GDM) is a disease of abnormal glucose metabolism that occurs during pregnancy, and its incidence rate is on the rise worldwide. Gestational diabetes is a common complication of pregnancy, which will bring adverse effects to the mother and fetus. Therefore, early diagnosis and timely intervention of pregnancy diabetes is essential to improve maternal and infant health. In the early prediction of gestational diabetes, it is of great significance to establish a good prediction model. First, we studied the relevant disease background, and emphasized the importance of prediction of gestational diabetes. Then, we made clear the purpose of this study, that is, to use the integrated learning method to build a model that accurately predicts gestational diabetes. In terms of methodology, we used multiple machine learning algorithms to construct classifiers and combined them into a more powerful model using Stacking techniques. These base classifiers include: RF (Random Forest), SVM (Support Vector Machine), XGBoost, CatBoost. During the experiment, we used real publicly available datasets and improved the performance of the model through strict data preprocessing and feature selection. Finally, through the experimental results and performance evaluation, we got a prediction model of pregnancy diabetes with high accuracy and low false positive rate. The results of this study show the effectiveness and superiority of Stacking integrated learning method in the prediction of gestational diabetes, providing a feasible solution for early diagnosis and intervention. The results of this study are of great significance to clinical doctors, public health workers, and patients.

articleTitle: Device Recognition Method for Internal Power Networks Based on Communication Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Due to the security zoning and isolation mechanisms within the internal power network, there is a lack of comprehensive knowledge of asset information in the network. Based on the information contained in network traffic, it is possible to effectively reflect the true attributes of devices. This paper addresses the characteristics of device traffic behavior in the internal power network and proposes a device recognition method based on communication graphs. The recognition method is based on clustering and communication graphs and consists of three stages. In the first stage, isolation devices are identified through clustering algorithms and as many server devices as possible are selected. In the second stage, server devices are identified based on the communication relationships with isolation devices. In the third stage, security devices are identified based on the graph structure in the communication graph. Experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively identify device attributes present in the internal power network.

articleTitle: A Versatile Low-Light Enhancement Module for Improved Workpiece Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: This study presents a versatile Low-Light Enhancement Module (LLEM) to enhance object detection models, particularly for workpieces in challenging lighting conditions. The LLEM seamlessly integrates into existing models, addressing low-light challenges through a denoising branch, a global branch, and a Structural Perception loss for image quality improvement. The denoising branch utilizes Residual Denoising Modules to effectively reduce noise and preserve low-level features. Meanwhile, the global branch focuses on color recovery and gamma correction. Experimental results show YOLOv3+LLEM significantly improves detection performance, achieving a mAP increase from 88.0% to 91.9%. This enhancement, especially with the introduction of Structural Perception loss, maintains computational efficiency, validating its practicality for industrial workpiece detection in low-light conditions.

articleTitle: A Method for Predicting and Evaluating Trajectory Tracking Errors in CNC Systems Based on Transformer and Fuzzy Integrated Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The machining accuracy and machining speed of the machine significantly impact the machining performance of the CNC system. However, the time-varying machining environment and complex working conditions increase the difficulty of predicting the trajectory tracking error and evaluating the trajectory of the CNC system. To address the aforementioned challenges, this paper presents a novel approach that utilizes the Transformer model and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to predict and evaluate the trajectory tracking error of CNC systems. Firstly, using the features of fast forward propagation, low structure complexity and high efficiency of feature extraction of the Transformer model, a trajectory tracking error prediction model based on the Transformer model is established to improve the accuracy of trajectory tracking error prediction. Then, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model for machining trajectories is established, using hierarchical analysis to determine the weights of indicators, construct evaluation levels and introduce the subordinate functions for each indicator evaluation. At the same time, the curvature-based trajectory-sensitive area selection algorithm is proposed to select the position information that has a more significant impact on the machining performance for analysis and evaluation. The effectiveness of the proposed approach has been demonstrated through the analysis and evaluation of machining trajectory data for the domestic Lantian CNC system's GJ430 model.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method for Accelerating Convolutional Neural Networks Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of slow deployment of convolutional neural networks in the central processing unit (CPU) and high power consumption in the graphics processing unit (GPU), the convolutional neural network (CNN) developed based on the field programmable gate array (FPGA) platform is adopted. ) recognition system, which can achieve the effect of improving the operation speed of the algorithm. FPGA is a reconfigurable hardware device that can be programmed to implement various logic functions and can be optimized according to specific applications. Through the design optimization of LeNet5, this paper designs a LeNet_Min network model with fewer parameters. Considering that the calculation amount of the algorithm and the consumption of logic resources are mainly concentrated in the convolution and pooling layers, a pipeline-based dual-channel data model is proposed. Comparison methods. In the pooling layer and activation function of convolutional neural network, flow pooling is designed, and the design method of activation function and pooling layer isomorphism is proposed. The test results show that the recognition speed of Letnet_Min is about 13 times that of the same network model realized by the CPU on the computer side, and higher than that of the GPU, and the system power consumption is only 1.96w. In addition, the system has high versatility and low resource occupation, and can be applied to other neural network models.

articleTitle: The Practice and Challenges of Virtual Reality Technology in Music Education
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Virtual reality (VR) technology is a type of digital technology that is currently active in fields such as gaming and film and television. It refers to people being able to interact with things in the virtual environment simulated by computers through interactive devices, creating a feeling of entering the real world. The emergence of VR technology has led to the innovation and upgrading of traditional teaching tools. It can not only stimulate students' interest in learning, but also enhance teaching effectiveness. Music education (MUE) needs to find new directions, strengthen the atmosphere of student self-directed learning, optimize the allocation and application of teaching resources, to improve teaching quality. This article designs a music teaching system based on VR technology, aiming to enhance the fun and interactivity of MUE, provide students with a more vivid and realistic learning experience, and achieve a new teaching mode. The experimental results indicate that this system has significant advantages and effects in MUE. Compared to traditional teaching methods, VR technology can improve the teaching effectiveness and efficiency of teachers, stimulate students’ interest and initiative in learning, and promote the digital transformation and growth of MUE.

articleTitle: FM-GAN: GAN-based Fusion of Multiple Networks for Low-Light Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Dark light image enhancement methods have important application value in various fields, including those based on traditional image processing techniques and those based on deep learning techniques. The current research hotspot is to use deep learning to solve this problem. However, existing enhancement methods still have the following problems: (1) Currently, the ultimate goal of most low light image enhancement methods is to enhance images to match human visual senses, without paying attention to providing convenience for object detection work. (2) Most existing enhancement methods do not pay sufficient attention to the detailed features of the image, focusing on the whole while ignoring the details, resulting in blurring and artifacts at the edges of the enhanced image details, unclear image contrast, and affecting subsequent object detection work. In response to the above issues, this article proposes an FM-GAN model suitable for low light image enhancement tasks, which includes an image generation module, an edge enhancement module, and a contrast enhancement module. The image generation module learns image features from unpaired datasets and generates high-quality normal lighting images. The edge enhancement module uses the extracted edge feature map combined with the generated image to enhance edge details and enhance the detailed features of the image. The contrast enhancement module uses dilated convolution to enhance image contrast representation, improving image quality and making image targets clearer and more visible.

articleTitle: A Method for Optimizing the Energy Storage Configuration on The Renewable Energy Side Based-on Improved HS-IMOPSO
publicationTitle: 2024 13th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The integration of renewable energy (RE) has a significant impact on the reliability and stability of power systems. Therefore, the introduction of ES systems is necessary to mitigate potential issues. ES systems can effectively reduce voltage fluctuations, enhance the efficient utilization of RE resources, and significantly decrease energy losses in the power network. This paper aims to develop a comprehensive model that considers system voltage fluctuations, network losses, and accumulated ES capacity for ES siting and sizing. To address the multi-objective optimization problem, we introduce an innovative multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm based on Harmony Search (HS-IMOPSO). This algorithm cleverly incorporates the principles of harmony and tone modulation from the Harmony Search method into the multi-objective particle swarm optimization framework, substantially reducing the risk of falling into local optima. We utilize data from the entire year of 2022 from a specific location, segmenting it into quarterly intervals and extracting representative daily data. The algorithm's validation is conducted using an IEEE33-node distribution system. Simulation results highlight the outstanding performance of the HS-IMOPSO algorithm in global search capabilities and the generation of a superior Pareto solution set.
